object_types.name: Student
object_types.definition: A person enrolled in course offerings at the university.

source_references.excerpt: Students enroll in course offerings, not in courses directly.
Students have a student number.

object_types.name: Course
object_types.definition: A subject of study that can be offered in one or more semesters.

source_references.excerpt: A course offering is a specific course offered in a specific semester.
Courses have a course code, like CS101.

object_types.name: CourseOffering
object_types.definition: A specific course offered in a specific semester, taught by an instructor, that students enroll in.

source_references.excerpt: A course offering is a specific course offered in a specific semester.

object_types.name: Instructor
object_types.definition: A staff member who teaches course offerings.

source_references.excerpt: Each offering is taught by exactly one instructor.

object_types.name: Semester

ambiguities.description: It's unclear whether an instructor can teach offerings across different semesters simultaneously or only within one semester at a time; the transcript only confirms multiple offerings within the same semester. Does the model need a constraint limiting an instructor's offerings per semester, or is it unbounded across all semesters?

source_references.excerpt: An instructor can teach several offerings in the same semester.

ambiguities.description: The maximum capacity of an offering is described as a cap on enrollment, but no fact type or constraint enforces that actual enrollment counts stay within this cap. Should the model include a derived/enforced constraint linking enrollment counts to MaximumCapacity, and is capacity mandatory for every offering?

source_references.excerpt: Each offering has a maximum capacity -- a cap on how many students can enroll.

ambiguities.description: The credit value is described as 'usually between 1 and 6' rather than as a strict rule, so it's ambiguous whether this is a hard value constraint or just a typical range with exceptions allowed. Should this be modeled as a strict value constraint (1-6) or left unconstrained?

source_references.excerpt: The credit value is a whole number, usually between 1 and 6.

ambiguities.description: The transcript treats course code, offering ID, staff ID, and semester code as simple identifiers, but it's not stated whether these are system-generated or human-assigned, and whether any historical reuse of codes (e.g. reusing an offering ID across semesters) is possible. Confirm identifier generation and uniqueness scope.
